description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'FormatWithTimeTest' that verifies the behavior of the 'FormatWithTime' class's 'getFormattedValue' method. It sets up the test environment and checks formatted time output for a DateTime object and a string input.

classes.name: FormatWithTimeTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'FormatWithTime' class's method 'getFormattedValue'.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the 'FormatWithTime' object before each test.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests that 'getFormattedValue' returns '00:00:00' for a DateTime object and null for an invalid string.
